backfill_note: The experiment ran on 2026-06-24 against @playwright/test 1.61.1. Its harness lived in a gitignored tmp/ dir and was deleted after publish per the finite-disk firsthand policy. The harness here (server.mjs + public/index.html + playwright.config.ts + tests/passkey.spec.ts) is reconstructed from the run's recorded methodology and the API ground truth read from the installed 1.61.1 types.d.ts, so a third party can reproduce the capability claims. results.json holds the qualitative matrix measured on 2026-06-24; re-running reproduces the same per-engine pass/fail capability outcomes (wall time drifts and is not an evidence claim).

environment.runner: Playwright Test runner, headless, 3 engine projects
environment.note: This checks whether Playwright's virtual authenticator drives the passkey (WebAuthn) ceremony across engines. It is a capability/behavior check, not a timing benchmark; CPU/GPU/RAM do not affect the pass/fail matrix.

subject.name: @playwright/test
subject.note: 1.61 promotes the virtual authenticator to a first-class context.credentials API across chromium/firefox/webkit; the pre-1.61 path was the CDP-only addVirtualAuthenticator, effectively Chromium-limited.

baseline.name: CDP addVirtualAuthenticator (pre-1.61)
baseline.note: Compared conceptually in the post (Chromium-only vs cross-engine). No CDP baseline code is executed in this run; the comparison is by capability, not by measured timing.

cross_engine.note: All three engines were exercised firsthand. Unlike a cited support table, the per-engine outcomes in results.json are observed pass/fail from the original run.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: harness discarded post-publish (finite-disk policy); reconstructed here
raw_artifacts.note: No large or binary artifacts. The original run reported 12/12 tests passing in ~6.4s; the wall time is machine-dependent and is recorded as context only, never as an evidence claim. The deterministic evidence is the per-engine capability matrix in results.json, re-derivable by running the harness on the pinned Playwright build.
